subject: Edge migration + retainer: proposed SLA uplift and regional capacity plan
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@galacticretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Myers <tom.myers@galacticretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@galacticretail.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation: capacity shift & support retainer

Marissa —

Quick recap from our side: Galactic Retail is approaching the end of year renewal and we want to: (1) increase peak capacity from current 600 RPS to 1,200 RPS across US regions with an automated burst safety net, (2) add a 24/7 retainer for white‑glove oncall during our Black Friday window, and (3) pilot a partial migration of edge/checkout traffic to a Private VPC deployment in us‑west for data locality.

Before next week’s call can you share a sketch of how those changes would map to Premium SLA tiers (p95/p99 targets, escalation timelines) and a ballpark of incremental cost? We’d also like an estimate for the operational runbook work and any one‑time migration fees.

We’re asking procurement to hold a PO for a renewal amendment pending the SOW.

Thanks —
Lara

Lara Chen
Head of Platform Operations, Galactic Retail
lara.chen@galacticretail.com
+1 415 555 0182

Attachments: none in initial email

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@galacticretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: capacity shift & support retainer

Lara, thanks — this is clear and timely. High level options below; I’ve attached an SOW draft, an SLA + cost matrix, and a short runbook outline for the edge pilot.

Option A — Premium Plus (recommended for Black Friday):
- Capacity: reserved 1,200 RPS across us‑west/us‑east with 25% burst pool (instant fallback to hosted);
- SLOs: p95 <= 80ms, p99 <= 350ms for gen endpoints (measured at ingress);
- Support: 24/7 retainer (30 oncall hours/month included) + priority engineering channel;
- One‑time: private VPC setup + runbook work estimated 120 engineering hours.

Option B — Stepped upgrade (lower cost):
- Capacity: reserve 900 RPS, 20% burst;
- SLOs: p95 <= 100ms, p99 <= 500ms;
- Support: business hours retainer + escalations for weekend Black Friday window;
- One‑time: 70 engineering hours.

Tradeoffs — A highlights: predictable tail latency during peak, faster incident kill‑chain (30 min escalation SLA to oncall eng). B is less costly but increases risk window during sustained spikes.

Ben, can you confirm the runbook estimate and whether the private VPC pilot can be scoped as a half‑day cutover per checkout region?

Next steps: we can send a final SOW + redlines for DocuSign by EOD Friday if you confirm preferred option.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Galactic_SOW_v2.pdf; SLA_and_Cost_Matrix.xlsx; edge-migration-runbook.md

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@galacticretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 13:50:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: capacity shift & support retainer

Lara — quick technical notes:
- Private VPC pilot: we can route a percentage of checkout traffic to a dedicated pool in us‑west. For a phased pilot we recommend 10%/50%/100% cutover windows with health checks baked into the routing policy.
- KV cache warmup: migration will see a cold cache on first hour; recommend a short prewarming job for the hottest prefixes (we can provide scripts).
- Tail latency: achieving p99 <= 350ms for inference at 1,200 RPS depends on model selection and batching window. If you want tighter p99 we should discuss quantization or a lower‑latency model shard for checkout paths.

I’ll attach the prewarm script and a short checklist to the runbook (included in the attached markdown).

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood
ben_carter@redwood.com

Cc: Tom Myers <tom.myers@galacticretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@galacticretail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: capacity shift & support retainer

Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turn. We reviewed with engineering and procurement: we’d like to move forward with Option A (Premium Plus) but have two asks before we sign: (1) narrow the p99 latency SLA for checkout to <= 300ms (we understand there may be a price impact), and (2) a guaranteed rollback playbook if the edge pilot causes checkout errors > 0.5% over a 15‑minute window.

Can you provide a revised SOW (with explicit rollback steps and acceptance tests) and an updated price delta for the tightened p99?

—Lara

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@galacticretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: capacity shift & support retainer

Lara — appreciate the specificity. We can commit to a 300ms p99 for checkout if Galactic accepts a two‑component change in the SOW: (1) a dedicated low‑latency model shard for checkout routes (adds licensing + 15% recurring cost), and (2) an expanded retainer (40 oncall hours/month) to cover rapid rollback/triage during BFD (adds fixed monthly retainer fee).

Rollback playbook summary (we’ll include full steps in revised SOW):
- Canary 10% → monitor checkout error rate and p99 for 30 mins;
- If errors > 0.5% over 15m or p99 > 350ms for > 10m, instant rollback to hosted variant + automated cache flush;
- Engage priority engineering channel and execute post‑mortem within 48 hours.

I attached an updated SLA_and_Cost_Matrix.xlsx with the specific line items. If that looks good we’ll send DocuSign SOW + PO instructions.

—Evelyn
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

Attachments: SLA_and_Cost_Matrix.xlsx (updated)

Team —

This matches our expectations. Galactic approves the revised terms: Premium Plus with dedicated checkout shard and expanded 40‑hour retainer. Procurement has the PO ready pending the SOW signature; please send the DocuSign link and final SOW. Also confirm the lead time for the private VPC pilot (we need the pilot in place two weeks before our holiday peak).
